title: Vintage Ivory Ceramic Teapot with Unique Loop Handle – Elegant Leaf Pattern
descriptionText:
This listing is for a vintage ivory ceramic teapot featuring a beautifully unique looped handle design and subtle embossed leaf pattern around the body. Its smooth ivory glaze and classic round form make it an elegant piece for both use and display.
Material: Glazed ceramic/porcelain
Color: Ivory/cream
Features:
Rare loop handle design with supporting rest
Embossed leaf motif around body and lid
Matching fitted lid with sculpted finial
Condition: Excellent pre-owned condition. No chips, cracks, or repairs observed. Some light wear consistent with age and use (see photos for details).
